data.one_liner: Detect if an Android device is rooted or an iOS device is jailbroken.
data.what_it_does: Provides getters to check root status on Android via RootBeer and jailbreak status on iOS via IOSSecuritySuite. Also offers a developer‑mode check (Android developer options, iOS simulator).
use_when: You need to block functionality on rooted or jailbroken devices
Compliance or security policies require device integrity checks
avoid_when: You only need generic device info without security checks
You require a cross‑platform solution that also handles emulators uniformly
strengths: Uses native libraries (RootBeer, IOSSecuritySuite) for reliable detection
Runs root checks on a background thread on Android
Supports Swift Package Manager and recent Flutter versions
weaknesses: Only provides boolean getters, no detailed reason codes
May throw PlatformException that must be handled
data.setup_notes: Add the plugin to pubspec, run flutter pub get; iOS requires CocoaPods or Swift Package Manager, Android minSdk 21.
